---
title: 'Combined Search + Filter & Non-Disruptive Clearing'
type: 'feature'
created: '2026-11-05'
status: 'draft'
review_loop_iteration: 0
context: []
baseline_commit: 'afb4d317b6cdd39d6fbf4d87943e5e0aae51da05'
---

<frozen-after-approval reason="human-owned intent — do not modify unless human renegotiates">

## Intent

**Problem:** `EntriesSearchCubit` (5.1) and `MeusRegistrosCubit`'s filters (5.2) are mutually inert — applying/clearing a filter during an active search silently no-ops, and a search query never carries the active filter.

**Approach:** Give `EntriesSearchCubit` its own filter fields plus `updateFilters()`; have `MeusRegistrosScreen` (the only place composing both cubits) call it alongside every existing filter-mutating call; have `_search()` forward those fields to `entries-search`. Clearing/removing a filter mid-search re-runs the same term with the new filter set — no query-box change, no reload.

## Boundaries & Constraints

**Always:**
- `EntriesRepository.search({required String query, EntrySource? source, DateTime? dateFrom, DateTime? dateTo})`; `EntriesRemoteDataSource.search()` forwards non-null values to `entries-search`, mirroring `list()`'s own convention (`.name`, `.toUtc().toIso8601String()`).
- `EntriesSearchCubit` gains `_activeSource`/`_activeDateFrom`/`_activeDateTo` + `_lastQuery` + `updateFilters({source, dateFrom, dateTo})`: always stores the fields; only when `_lastQuery` is non-empty, cancels any pending debounce and immediately re-runs `_search(_lastQuery)` with the new filters, bumping `_generation` (same race-guard `_search` already uses). While idle: silent storage, no call.
- `_search(query)` passes `source`/`dateFrom`/`dateTo` to `_repository.search()` alongside `query`.
- `MeusRegistrosScreen` threads `searchCubit` into `EntriesFilterSheet`/`_ActiveFiltersRow` (new required param on both); their 4 filter-mutating call sites (`_applyAndClose`, chip-remove ×2, "Limpar filtros") also call `searchCubit.updateFilters(...)` right after the existing `cubit.applyFilters()`/`clearFilters()`.
- Funnel fill (`meus_registros_screen.dart:217-219`) drops its `ResourceIdle` gate — becomes `widget.cubit.hasActiveFilters` unconditionally. `_ActiveFiltersRow` renders above `_SearchResults` too, same condition.
- Clearing the search box while filters stay active needs no new code — `MeusRegistrosCubit`'s filtered state is already kept current in the background regardless of which branch is visible (5.2, unchanged).

**Ask First:** none — scope pinned by `epic-5-context.md` and RF06.

**Never:** `EntriesSearchCubit`/`MeusRegistrosCubit` importing each other (RNF06) — filters flow only via the screen's `updateFilters()` bridge; a debounce on the filter-triggered re-search (only keystrokes debounce); a "CATEGORIA"/tag filter; changing `_loadFiltered()`'s own background `entries-list` query.

## I/O & Edge-Case Matrix

| Scenario | Input / State | Expected Output / Behavior | Error Handling |
|----------|--------------|---------------------------|----------------|
| Apply filter during active search | search "ansiedade" active, Aplicar "áudio" | one `entries-search` call: `q=ansiedade&source=audio` | N/A |
| Clear filters during active search | source+date active + search term, "Limpar filtros" tapped | re-queries `entries-search` with only `q`; box/screen undisturbed | N/A |
| Remove one of two chips mid-search | source+date active, search active, "x" on source chip | re-queries `entries-search` with `q` + remaining date range | N/A |
| Apply filter while search idle | empty box, Aplicar "áudio" | stored on `EntriesSearchCubit` silently; `entries-list` queried (5.2 path), no `entries-search` call | N/A |
| Clear search box, filters active | query cleared to empty | falls back to `MeusRegistrosCubit`'s already-current filtered list, no new call | N/A |

</frozen-after-approval>

## Code Map

- `entries_repository.dart:88` -- `search()` signature to extend
- `entries_remote_data_source.dart:125-143` -- `search()` param-building, mirrors `list()` (:65-96)
- `entries_repository_impl.dart:135-136` -- thin pass-through, unaffected beyond new params
- `entries_search_cubit.dart:20-100` -- add filter fields/`_lastQuery`/`updateFilters()`; extend `_search()`
- `meus_registros_screen.dart:208-223` (fill gate), `:260-282` (chip-row branch), `:656-710` (`_ActiveFiltersRow`)
- `entries_filter_sheet.dart:38-96,121-130` (`_applyAndClose`)
- `meus_registros_cubit.dart` -- unchanged; `activeSource`/`activeDateFrom`/`activeDateTo` getters reused read-only
- `date_range_preset.dart` -- unchanged

## Tasks & Acceptance

**Execution:**
- [ ] `entries_repository.dart` -- add `source`/`dateFrom`/`dateTo` to `search()`
- [ ] `entries_remote_data_source.dart` -- forward new params to `entries-search`
- [ ] `entries_search_cubit.dart` -- add filter fields, `_lastQuery`, `updateFilters()`; wire into `_search()`
- [ ] `entries_filter_sheet.dart` -- add `searchCubit` param; bridge in `_applyAndClose`
- [ ] `meus_registros_screen.dart` -- pass `searchCubit` down; bridge chip-remove/"Limpar"; drop funnel's `ResourceIdle` gate; render chip row over search results too
- [ ] Unit tests covering every I/O Matrix row
- [ ] Widget tests: chip row + funnel fill during active search; Aplicar/Limpar/chip-remove mid-search re-querying `entries-search` correctly

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- Given an active search term and no filters, when a filter is applied, then the funnel fills and the chip row appears above the search results.
- Given combined search+filter results on screen, when "Limpar filtros" is tapped, then results update to unfiltered semantic-search results for the same query, with no search-box or screen disruption.

## Design Notes

Filter state is duplicated, not shared, between the two cubits — RNF06 forbids one importing the other, so `MeusRegistrosScreen` (already composing both) is the only legitimate place to copy a filter change into `updateFilters()`.

## Verification

**Commands:**
- `fvm flutter analyze` -- expected: zero issues
- `fvm flutter test` -- expected: all tests pass

**Approach:** Give `EntriesSearchCubit` its own filter fields plus `updateFilters()`; have `MeusRegistrosScreen` (the only place composing both cubits) call it alongside every existing filter-mutating call; have `_search()` forward those fields to `entries-search`. **Always:**

While idle: silent storage, no call.
- `_search(query)` passes `source`/`dateFrom`/`dateTo` to `_repository.search()` alongside `query`.

- Clearing the search box while filters stay active needs no new code — `MeusRegistrosCubit`'s filtered state is already kept current in the background regardless of which branch is visible (5.2, unchanged).

## Intent

**Problem:** `EntriesSearchCubit` (5.1) and `MeusRegistrosCubit`'s filters (5.2) are mutually inert — applying/clearing a filter during an active search silently no-ops, and a search query never carries the active filter.

**Approach:** Give `EntriesSearchCubit` its own filter fields plus `updateFilters()`; have `MeusRegistrosScreen` (the only place composing both cubits) call it alongside every existing filter-mutating call; have `_search()` forward those fields to `entries-search`. Clearing/removing a filter mid-search re-runs the same term with the new filter set — no query-box change, no reload.

## Boundaries & Constraints

**Always:**
- `EntriesRepository.search({required String query, EntrySource? source, DateTime? dateFrom, DateTime? dateTo})`; `EntriesRemoteDataSource.search()` forwards non-null values to `entries-search`, mirroring `list()`'s own convention (`.name`, `.toUtc().toIso8601String()`).
- `EntriesSearchCubit` gains `_activeSource`/`_activeDateFrom`/`_activeDateTo` + `_lastQuery` + `updateFilters({source, dateFrom, dateTo})`: always stores the fields; only when `_lastQuery` is non-empty, cancels any pending debounce and immediately re-runs `_search(_lastQuery)`, bumping `_generation` (same race-guard `_search` already uses). While idle: silent storage, no call.
- `_search(query)` passes `source`/`dateFrom`/`dateTo` to `_repository.search()` alongside `query`.
- `MeusRegistrosScreen` threads `searchCubit` into `EntriesFilterSheet`/`_ActiveFiltersRow` (new required param on both); their 4 filter-mutating call sites (`_applyAndClose`, chip-remove ×2, "Limpar filtros") also call `searchCubit.updateFilters(...)` right after the existing `cubit.applyFilters()`/`clearFilters()`.
- Funnel fill (`meus_registros_screen.dart:217-219`) drops its `ResourceIdle` gate — becomes `widget.cubit.hasActiveFilters` unconditionally. `_ActiveFiltersRow` renders above `_SearchResults` too, same condition.
- Clearing the search box while filters stay active needs no new code — `MeusRegistrosCubit`'s filtered state is already kept current in the background regardless of which branch is visible (5.2, unchanged).
- `MeusRegistrosScreen.initState()`'s existing `cubit.loadFirstPage()` call also calls `searchCubit.updateFilters(source: null, dateFrom: null, dateTo: null)` — both cubits are `lazySingleton`s, so a fresh mount must reset both, or a re-entered screen carries a stale filter from a previous visit into a still-active search.

**Ask First:** none — scope pinned by `epic-5-context.md` and RF06.

**Never:** `EntriesSearchCubit`/`MeusRegistrosCubit` importing each other (RNF06) — filters flow only via the screen's bridge; a debounce on the filter-triggered re-search (only keystrokes debounce); a "CATEGORIA"/tag filter; changing `_loadFiltered()`'s own background `entries-list` query.

## I/O & Edge-Case Matrix

| Scenario | Input / State | Expected Output / Behavior | Error Handling |
|----------|--------------|---------------------------|----------------|
| Apply filter during active search | search "ansiedade" active, Aplicar "áudio" | one `entries-search` call: `q=ansiedade&source=audio` | N/A |
| Clear filters during active search | source+date active + search term, "Limpar filtros" tapped | re-queries `entries-search` with only `q`; box/screen undisturbed | N/A |
| Remove one of two chips mid-search | source+date active, search active, "x" on source chip | re-queries `entries-search` with `q` + remaining date range | N/A |
| Filter applied/cleared/box emptied while search idle | empty box | stored silently; `entries-list` queried (5.2 path, unchanged), no `entries-search` call | N/A |
| Re-enter screen after a prior combined session | leave with search+filter active, return | both cubits' filters reset on `initState`; no stale filter carried forward | N/A |

</frozen-after-approval>

- `entries_remote_data_source.dart:125-143` -- `search()` param-building, mirrors `list()` (:65-96)

- `meus_registros_cubit.dart` -- unchanged; `activeSource`/`activeDateFrom`/`activeDateTo` getters reused read-only
- `date_range_preset.dart` -- unchanged

**Execution:**

- [ ] `entries_remote_data_source.dart` -- forward new params to `entries-search`
- [ ] `entries_search_cubit.dart` -- add filter fields, `_lastQuery`, `updateFilters()`; wire into `_search()`
- [ ] `entries_filter_sheet.dart` -- add `searchCubit` param; bridge in `_applyAndClose`

- [ ] Unit tests covering every I/O Matrix row

content.text:
The spec is drafted at **1622 tokens**, slightly above the 1600 target (the previous story's round-2 review already flagged how much implicit state this screen juggles, and the mount-reset edge case I found during self-review added real content, not padding).

**Spec:** `_bmad-output/implementation-artifacts/spec-5-3-combined-search-filter-non-disruptive-clearing.md`

**Summary:** Story 5.3 makes search (5.1) and filters (5.2) actually combine. Today they're inert toward each other — applying a filter during an active search silently no-ops, and a search query never carries filter params. The fix:
- Extend `EntriesRepository.search()`/`EntriesRemoteDataSource.search()` with `source`/`dateFrom`/`dateTo`, mirroring `list()`'s existing convention.
- Give `EntriesSearchCubit` its own filter fields + `updateFilters()`, which immediately re-runs the active search with new filters (no debounce — only keystrokes debounce).
- `MeusRegistrosScreen` bridges both cubits at every filter-mutating call site (it's the one place RNF06 allows this, since cubits can't import each other).
- Funnel-fill and the active-filter chip row now show during an active search too, not just the plain timeline.
- Caught in self-review: both cubits are long-lived singletons, so a screen re-mount must reset both — not just `MeusRegistrosCubit` as today — or a stale filter leaks into a fresh visit's search.

This is a single-goal spec (not multi-goal): everything here is one depends-on-both-5.1-and-5.2 behavior — the combined query and the non-disruptive clearing are two faces of the same wiring job, not separable deliverables.

---

title: 'Combined Search + Filter & Non-Disruptive Clearing'
type: 'feature'
created: '2026-11-05'
status: 'draft'
review_loop_iteration: 0
context: []
baseline_commit: 'afb4d317b6cdd39d6fbf4d87943e5e0aae51da05'
---

<frozen-after-approval reason="human-owned intent — do not modify unless human renegotiates">

## Intent

**Problem:** `EntriesSearchCubit` (5.1) and `MeusRegistrosCubit`'s filters (5.2) are mutually inert — applying/clearing a filter during an active search silently no-ops, and a search query never carries the active filter.

**Approach:** Give `EntriesSearchCubit` its own filter fields plus `updateFilters()`; have `MeusRegistrosScreen` (the only place composing both cubits) call it alongside every existing filter-mutating call; have `_search()` forward those fields to `entries-search`. Clearing/removing a filter mid-search re-runs the same term with the new filter set — no query-box change, no reload.

## Boundaries & Constraints

**Always:**
- `EntriesRepository.search({required String query, EntrySource? source, DateTime? dateFrom, DateTime? dateTo})`; `EntriesRemoteDataSource.search()` forwards non-null values to `entries-search`, mirroring `list()`'s own convention (`.name`, `.toUtc().toIso8601String()`).
- `EntriesSearchCubit` gains `_activeSource`/`_activeDateFrom`/`_activeDateTo` + `_lastQuery` + `updateFilters({source, dateFrom, dateTo})`: always stores the fields; only when `_lastQuery` is non-empty, cancels any pending debounce and immediately re-runs `_search(_lastQuery)`, bumping `_generation` (same race-guard `_search` already uses). While idle: silent storage, no call.
- `_search(query)` passes `source`/`dateFrom`/`dateTo` to `_repository.search()` alongside `query`.
- `MeusRegistrosScreen` threads `searchCubit` into `EntriesFilterSheet`/`_ActiveFiltersRow` (new required param on both); their 4 filter-mutating call sites (`_applyAndClose`, chip-remove ×2, "Limpar filtros") also call `searchCubit.updateFilters(...)` right after the existing `cubit.applyFilters()`/`clearFilters()`.
- Funnel fill (`meus_registros_screen.dart:217-219`) drops its `ResourceIdle` gate — becomes `widget.cubit.hasActiveFilters` unconditionally. `_ActiveFiltersRow` renders above `_SearchResults` too, same condition.
- Clearing the search box while filters stay active needs no new code — `MeusRegistrosCubit`'s filtered state is already kept current in the background regardless of which branch is visible (5.2, unchanged).
- `MeusRegistrosScreen.initState()`'s existing `cubit.loadFirstPage()` call also calls `searchCubit.updateFilters(source: null, dateFrom: null, dateTo: null)` — both cubits are `lazySingleton`s, so a fresh mount must reset both, or a re-entered screen carries a stale filter from a previous visit into a still-active search.

**Ask First:** none — scope pinned by `epic-5-context.md` and RF06.

**Never:** the two cubits importing each other (RNF06) — filters flow only via the screen bridge; a debounce on the filter-triggered re-search; a "CATEGORIA"/tag filter; changing `_loadFiltered()`'s own background `entries-list` query.

## I/O & Edge-Case Matrix

| Scenario | Input / State | Expected Output / Behavior | Error Handling |
|----------|--------------|---------------------------|----------------|
| Apply filter during active search | search "ansiedade" active, Aplicar "áudio" | one `entries-search` call: `q=ansiedade&source=audio` | N/A |
| Clear filters during active search | source+date active + search term, "Limpar filtros" tapped | re-queries `entries-search` with only `q`; box/screen undisturbed | N/A |
| Remove one of two chips mid-search | source+date active, search active, "x" on source chip | re-queries `entries-search` with `q` + remaining date range | N/A |
| Filter applied/cleared/box emptied while search idle | empty box | stored silently; `entries-list` queried (5.2 path, unchanged), no `entries-search` call | N/A |
| Re-enter screen after a prior combined session | leave with search+filter active, return | both cubits' filters reset on `initState`; no stale filter carried forward | N/A |

</frozen-after-approval>

## Code Map

- `entries_repository.dart:88` -- `search()` signature to extend (`entries_repository_impl.dart:135-136` is a thin pass-through, unaffected beyond the new params)
- `entries_remote_data_source.dart:125-143` -- `search()` param-building, mirrors `list()` (:65-96)
- `entries_search_cubit.dart:20-100` -- add filter fields/`_lastQuery`/`updateFilters()`; extend `_search()`
- `meus_registros_screen.dart:87-90` (`initState`), `:208-223` (fill gate), `:260-282` (chip-row branch), `:656-710` (`_ActiveFiltersRow`)
- `entries_filter_sheet.dart:38-96,121-130` (`_applyAndClose`)
- `meus_registros_cubit.dart` -- unchanged; `activeSource`/`activeDateFrom`/`activeDateTo` getters reused read-only
- `date_range_preset.dart` -- unchanged

## Tasks & Acceptance

**Execution:**
- [ ] `entries_repository.dart` -- add `source`/`dateFrom`/`dateTo` to `search()`
- [ ] `entries_remote_data_source.dart` -- forward new params to `entries-search`
- [ ] `entries_search_cubit.dart` -- add filter fields, `_lastQuery`, `updateFilters()`; wire into `_search()`
- [ ] `entries_filter_sheet.dart` -- add `searchCubit` param; bridge in `_applyAndClose`
- [ ] `meus_registros_screen.dart` -- pass `searchCubit` down; bridge chip-remove/"Limpar"; drop funnel's `ResourceIdle` gate; render chip row over search results too; reset `searchCubit`'s filters in `initState`
- [ ] Unit tests covering every I/O Matrix row
- [ ] Widget tests: chip row + funnel fill during active search; Aplicar/Limpar/chip-remove mid-search

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- Given an active search term and no filters, when a filter is applied, then the funnel fills and the chip row appears above the search results.
- Given combined search+filter results on screen, when "Limpar filtros" is tapped, then results update to unfiltered semantic-search results for the same query, with no search-box or screen disruption.

## Design Notes

Filter state is duplicated, not shared — RNF06 forbids one cubit importing the other, so the screen is the only legitimate bridge.

## Verification

**Commands:**
- `fvm flutter analyze` -- expected: zero issues
- `fvm flutter test` -- expected: all tests pass

| Scenario | Input / State | Expected Output / Behavior | Error Handling |

| Apply filter during active search | search "ansiedade" active, Aplicar "áudio" | one `entries-search` call: `q=ansiedade&source=audio` | N/A |
| Clear filters during active search | source+date active + search term, "Limpar filtros" tapped | re-queries `entries-search` with only `q`; box/screen undisturbed | N/A |

# Sync Sprint Status

Shared sub-step for updating `sprint-status.yaml` during build. Called from any route (plan-code-review, one-shot, future routes) with a `target_status` parameter.

## Preconditions

Skip this entire file (return to caller) if ANY of:
- `story_key` is unset
- `/Users/wagnerduarte/Documents/Faculdade/2026.2/TCC/cerne-ciclo-b/_bmad-output/implementation-artifacts/sprint-status.yaml` does not exist on disk

## Instructions

1. Load the FULL `/Users/wagnerduarte/Documents/Faculdade/2026.2/TCC/cerne-ciclo-b/_bmad-output/implementation-artifacts/sprint-status.yaml` file.
2. Find the `development_status` entry matching `{story_key}`. If not found, warn the user once (`"{story_key} not found in sprint-status; skipping sprint sync"`) and return to caller.
3. **Idempotency check.** If `development_status[{story_key}]` is already at `target_status` or a later state (`review` is later than `in-progress`; `done` is later than both), return to caller — no write needed. Never regress a story's status.
4. Set `development_status[{story_key}]` to `{target_status}`.
5. **Epic lift (only when `target_status` = `in-progress`).** Derive the parent epic key as `epic-{N}` from the leading numeric segment of `{story_key}` (e.g., `3-2-digest-delivery` → `epic-3`). If that entry exists and is `backlog`, set it to `in-progress`. Leave it alone otherwise. Skip this sub-step entirely when `target_status` is not `in-progress`.
6. Refresh `last_updated` to the current date.
7. Save the file, preserving ALL comments and structure including STATUS DEFINITIONS and WORKFLOW NOTES.

13	## Intent
14	
15	**Problem:** `EntriesSearchCubit` (5.1) and `MeusRegistrosCubit`'s filters (5.2) are mutually inert — applying/clearing a filter during an active search silently no-ops, and a search query never carries the active filter.
16	
17	**Approach:** Give `EntriesSearchCubit` its own filter fields plus `updateFilters()`; have `MeusRegistrosScreen` (the only place composing both cubits) call it alongside every existing filter-mutating call; have `_search()` forward those fields to `entries-search`. Clearing/removing a filter mid-search re-runs the same term with the new filter set — no query-box change, no reload.
18	
19	## Boundaries & Constraints
20	
21	**Always:**
22	- `EntriesRepository.search({required String query, EntrySource? source, DateTime? dateFrom, DateTime? dateTo})`; `EntriesRemoteDataSource.search()` forwards non-null values to `entries-search`, mirroring `list()`'s own convention (`.name`, `.toUtc().toIso8601String()`).

While idle: silent storage, no call.
24	- `_search(query)` passes `source`/`dateFrom`/`dateTo` to `_repository.search()` alongside `query`.

---
title: 'Combined Search + Filter & Non-Disruptive Clearing'
type: 'feature'
created: '2026-11-05'
status: 'done'
review_loop_iteration: 0
context: []
baseline_commit: 'afb4d317b6cdd39d6fbf4d87943e5e0aae51da05'
---

<frozen-after-approval reason="human-owned intent — do not modify unless human renegotiates">

## Intent

**Problem:** `EntriesSearchCubit` (5.1) and `MeusRegistrosCubit`'s filters (5.2) are mutually inert — applying/clearing a filter during an active search silently no-ops, and a search query never carries the active filter.

**Approach:** Give `EntriesSearchCubit` its own filter fields plus `updateFilters()`; have `MeusRegistrosScreen` (the only place composing both cubits) call it alongside every existing filter-mutating call; have `_search()` forward those fields to `entries-search`. Clearing/removing a filter mid-search re-runs the same term with the new filter set — no query-box change, no reload.

## Boundaries & Constraints

**Always:**
- `EntriesRepository.search({required String query, EntrySource? source, DateTime? dateFrom, DateTime? dateTo})`; `EntriesRemoteDataSource.search()` forwards non-null values to `entries-search`, mirroring `list()`'s own convention (`.name`, `.toUtc().toIso8601String()`).
- `EntriesSearchCubit` gains `_activeSource`/`_activeDateFrom`/`_activeDateTo` + `_lastQuery` + `updateFilters({source, dateFrom, dateTo})`: always stores the fields; only when `_lastQuery` is non-empty, cancels any pending debounce and immediately re-runs `_search(_lastQuery)`, bumping `_generation` (same race-guard `_search` already uses). While idle: silent storage, no call.
- `_search(query)` passes `source`/`dateFrom`/`dateTo` to `_repository.search()` alongside `query`.
- `MeusRegistrosScreen` threads `searchCubit` into `EntriesFilterSheet`/`_ActiveFiltersRow` (new required param on both); their 4 filter-mutating call sites (`_applyAndClose`, chip-remove ×2, "Limpar filtros") also call `searchCubit.updateFilters(...)` right after the existing `cubit.applyFilters()`/`clearFilters()`.
- Funnel fill (`meus_registros_screen.dart:217-219`) drops its `ResourceIdle` gate — becomes `widget.cubit.hasActiveFilters` unconditionally. `_ActiveFiltersRow` renders above `_SearchResults` too, same condition.
- Clearing the search box while filters stay active needs no new code — `MeusRegistrosCubit`'s filtered state is already kept current in the background regardless of which branch is visible (5.2, unchanged).
- `MeusRegistrosScreen.initState()`'s existing `cubit.loadFirstPage()` call also calls `searchCubit.updateFilters(source: null, dateFrom: null, dateTo: null)` — both cubits are `lazySingleton`s, so a fresh mount must reset both, or a re-entered screen carries a stale filter from a previous visit into a still-active search.

**Ask First:** none — scope pinned by `epic-5-context.md` and RF06.

**Never:** the two cubits importing each other (RNF06) — filters flow only via the screen bridge; a debounce on the filter-triggered re-search; a "CATEGORIA"/tag filter; changing `_loadFiltered()`'s own background `entries-list` query.

## I/O & Edge-Case Matrix

| Scenario | Input / State | Expected Output / Behavior | Error Handling |
|----------|--------------|---------------------------|----------------|
| Apply filter during active search | search "ansiedade" active, Aplicar "áudio" | one `entries-search` call: `q=ansiedade&source=audio` | N/A |
| Clear filters during active search | source+date active + search term, "Limpar filtros" tapped | re-queries `entries-search` with only `q`; box/screen undisturbed | N/A |
| Remove one of two chips mid-search | source+date active, search active, "x" on source chip | re-queries `entries-search` with `q` + remaining date range | N/A |
| Filter applied/cleared/box emptied while search idle | empty box | stored silently; `entries-list` queried (5.2 path, unchanged), no `entries-search` call | N/A |
| Re-enter screen after a prior combined session | leave with search+filter active, return | both cubits' filters reset on `initState`; no stale filter carried forward | N/A |

</frozen-after-approval>

## Code Map

- `entries_repository.dart:88` -- `search()` signature to extend (`entries_repository_impl.dart:135-136` is a thin pass-through, unaffected beyond the new params)
- `entries_remote_data_source.dart:125-143` -- `search()` param-building, mirrors `list()` (:65-96)
- `entries_search_cubit.dart:20-100` -- add filter fields/`_lastQuery`/`updateFilters()`; extend `_search()`
- `meus_registros_screen.dart:87-90` (`initState`), `:208-223` (fill gate), `:260-282` (chip-row branch), `:656-710` (`_ActiveFiltersRow`)
- `entries_filter_sheet.dart:38-96,121-130` (`_applyAndClose`)
- `meus_registros_cubit.dart` -- unchanged; `activeSource`/`activeDateFrom`/`activeDateTo` getters reused read-only
- `date_range_preset.dart` -- unchanged

## Tasks & Acceptance

**Execution:**
- [x] `entries_repository.dart` -- add `source`/`dateFrom`/`dateTo` to `search()`
- [x] `entries_remote_data_source.dart` -- forward new params to `entries-search`
- [x] `entries_search_cubit.dart` -- add filter fields, `_lastQuery`, `updateFilters()`; wire into `_search()`
- [x] `entries_filter_sheet.dart` -- add `searchCubit` param; bridge in `_applyAndClose`
- [x] `meus_registros_screen.dart` -- pass `searchCubit` down; bridge chip-remove/"Limpar"; drop funnel's `ResourceIdle` gate; render chip row over search results too; reset `searchCubit`'s filters in `initState`
- [x] Unit tests covering every I/O Matrix row
- [x] Widget tests: chip row + funnel fill during active search; Aplicar/Limpar/chip-remove mid-search

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- Given an active search term and no filters, when a filter is applied, then the funnel fills and the chip row appears above the search results.
- Given combined search+filter results on screen, when "Limpar filtros" is tapped, then results update to unfiltered semantic-search results for the same query, with no search-box or screen disruption.

## Design Notes

Filter state is duplicated, not shared — RNF06 forbids one cubit importing the other, so the screen is the only legitimate bridge.

## Verification

**Commands:**
- `fvm flutter analyze` -- expected: zero issues
- `fvm flutter test` -- expected: all tests pass

The two sections added ("Story 5.2 — metadata filters, round-2 code review" and "... real-pipeline E2E gap") only document 5.2 work, even though one of this very diff's own round-2 findings for 5.2 calls out "No test-summary.md entry exists for story 5-2... breaks the pattern every prior story ... followed" — that same gap now recurs for 5.3.

If `list()` actually builds its map with the conventional `if (x != null) 'key': value` collection-if idiom, the same class now has two different idioms for the identical "send only when present" behavior, and the unusual `?expr` syntax has no inline comment at the call site itself (only the method doc above it).
  
  - `EntriesSearchCubit.updateFilters()` always fully replaces all three filter fields — any omitted named argument resets that field to `null` rather than being left alone. Every current call site relies on this correctly, but neither the method's doc nor its name ("update…", which usually implies a partial/incremental update) states the full-replace contract explicitly, unlike `MeusRegistrosCubit.applyFilters()`, whose name at least hints at "apply a whole new selection."

Nothing enforces that lockstep; a future call site that updates one cubit and forgets the other would silently desync chip labels/funnel state from what the active search actually sent, with no compile-time or runtime check catching it.

Code review (step-04 of the build workflow) ran against your diff for spec-5-3-combined-search-filter-non-disruptive-clearing.md. Four findings survived triage as `patch` (auto-fix, no spec change needed) — please apply all four, then re-run `fvm flutter analyze` and `fvm flutter test` and confirm both are clean.

1. **Race: `EntriesSearchCubit.updateFilters()` has no `isClosed` guard before its synchronous call to `_search()`.** File: `lib/features/entries/presentation/cubit/entries_search_cubit.dart`. `_search()`'s first line is `emit(ResourceLoading())` — if `close()` races a call to `updateFilters()` (now a real risk since `MeusRegistrosScreen.initState()` calls it unconditionally on every mount), that `emit()` throws `StateError: Cannot emit after close`. `onQueryChanged`'s own empty-query branch already guards this exact hazard with `if (isClosed) return;` right before its `emit()` — add the same guard in `updateFilters()` before the `_search(_lastQuery)` call.

2. **Wasted network call: `updateFilters()` always re-runs `_search()` when a search is active, even when the new filter values are identical to what's already stored.** Same file. Since `initState()` now unconditionally calls `searchCubit.updateFilters(source: null, dateFrom: null, dateTo: null)` on every mount, every remount while a search is active but no filter was ever applied fires a redundant `entries-search` call (a real backend embedding-search call, not free). Fix: in `updateFilters()`, after storing the fields, skip the debounce-cancel + `_search()` call when `source == _activeSource && dateFrom == _activeDateFrom && dateTo == _activeDateTo` (compare before overwriting, or capture old values first) — i.e., only re-search when something actually changed. This doesn't touch the frozen spec text (`initState()` still calls `updateFilters()` unconditionally exactly as specified) — it only makes `updateFilters()` itself a no-op when there's nothing new to apply.

3. **Stale doc comment in `test/features/entries/presentation/widgets/entries_filter_sheet_test.dart`'s `_FakeEntriesRepository` class doc.** It claims `search()` resolves "with whatever is next in `[_searchResults]` (defaulting to an empty list...)" — but there is no `_searchResults` field in that fake at all; `search()` unconditionally `return right(const [])`. Fix the comment to describe the actual behavior.

4. **`_bmad-output/implementation-artifacts/tests/test-summary.md` has no entry for story 5-3 itself** — the two sections you added only document story 5.2's bundled work. Add a section for story 5-3 following the same pattern as the existing per-story entries in that file (e.g. the 5-1/5-2 sections right above).

Two other findings from review were triaged as pre-existing (not caused by this story) and deferred to `deferred-work.md` instead — no action needed on those from you.

title: 'Combined Search + Filter & Non-Disruptive Clearing'
type: 'feature'
created: '2026-11-05'
status: 'in-review'

context: []
baseline_commit: 'afb4d317b6cdd39d6fbf4d87943e5e0aae51da05'

<frozen-after-approval reason="human-owned intent — do not modify unless human renegotiates">

## Intent

**Problem:** `EntriesSearchCubit` (5.1) and `MeusRegistrosCubit`'s filters (5.2) are mutually inert — applying/clearing a filter during an active search silently no-ops, and a search query never carries the active filter.

**Approach:** Give `EntriesSearchCubit` its own filter fields plus `updateFilters()`; have `MeusRegistrosScreen` (the only place composing both cubits) call it alongside every existing filter-mutating call; have `_search()` forward those fields to `entries-search`. Clearing/removing a filter mid-search re-runs the same term with the new filter set — no query-box change, no reload.

## Boundaries & Constraints

**Always:**
- `EntriesRepository.search({required String query, EntrySource? source, DateTime? dateFrom, DateTime? dateTo})`; `EntriesRemoteDataSource.search()` forwards non-null values to `entries-search`, mirroring `list()`'s own convention (`.name`, `.toUtc().toIso8601String()`).
- `EntriesSearchCubit` gains `_activeSource`/`_activeDateFrom`/`_activeDateTo` + `_lastQuery` + `updateFilters({source, dateFrom, dateTo})`: always stores the fields; only when `_lastQuery` is non-empty, cancels any pending debounce and immediately re-runs `_search(_lastQuery)`, bumping `_generation` (same race-guard `_search` already uses). While idle: silent storage, no call.
- `_search(query)` passes `source`/`dateFrom`/`dateTo` to `_repository.search()` alongside `query`.
- `MeusRegistrosScreen` threads `searchCubit` into `EntriesFilterSheet`/`_ActiveFiltersRow` (new required param on both); their 4 filter-mutating call sites (`_applyAndClose`, chip-remove ×2, "Limpar filtros") also call `searchCubit.updateFilters(...)` right after the existing `cubit.applyFilters()`/`clearFilters()`.
- Funnel fill (`meus_registros_screen.dart:217-219`) drops its `ResourceIdle` gate — becomes `widget.cubit.hasActiveFilters` unconditionally. `_ActiveFiltersRow` renders above `_SearchResults` too, same condition.
- Clearing the search box while filters stay active needs no new code — `MeusRegistrosCubit`'s filtered state is already kept current in the background regardless of which branch is visible (5.2, unchanged).
- `MeusRegistrosScreen.initState()`'s existing `cubit.loadFirstPage()` call also calls `searchCubit.updateFilters(source: null, dateFrom: null, dateTo: null)` — both cubits are `lazySingleton`s, so a fresh mount must reset both, or a re-entered screen carries a stale filter from a previous visit into a still-active search.

**Ask First:** none — scope pinned by `epic-5-context.md` and RF06.

**Never:** the two cubits importing each other (RNF06) — filters flow only via the screen bridge; a debounce on the filter-triggered re-search; a "CATEGORIA"/tag filter; changing `_loadFiltered()`'s own background `entries-list` query.

## I/O & Edge-Case Matrix

| Scenario | Input / State | Expected Output / Behavior | Error Handling |
|----------|--------------|---------------------------|----------------|
| Apply filter during active search | search "ansiedade" active, Aplicar "áudio" | one `entries-search` call: `q=ansiedade&source=audio` | N/A |
| Clear filters during active search | source+date active + search term, "Limpar filtros" tapped | re-queries `entries-search` with only `q`; box/screen undisturbed | N/A |
| Remove one of two chips mid-search | source+date active, search active, "x" on source chip | re-queries `entries-search` with `q` + remaining date range | N/A |
| Filter applied/cleared/box emptied while search idle | empty box | stored silently; `entries-list` queried (5.2 path, unchanged), no `entries-search` call | N/A |
| Re-enter screen after a prior combined session | leave with search+filter active, return | both cubits' filters reset on `initState`; no stale filter carried forward | N/A |

</frozen-after-approval>

## Code Map

- `entries_repository.dart:88` -- `search()` signature to extend (`entries_repository_impl.dart:135-136` is a thin pass-through, unaffected beyond the new params)
- `entries_remote_data_source.dart:125-143` -- `search()` param-building, mirrors `list()` (:65-96)
- `entries_search_cubit.dart:20-100` -- add filter fields/`_lastQuery`/`updateFilters()`; extend `_search()`
- `meus_registros_screen.dart:87-90` (`initState`), `:208-223` (fill gate), `:260-282` (chip-row branch), `:656-710` (`_ActiveFiltersRow`)
- `entries_filter_sheet.dart:38-96,121-130` (`_applyAndClose`)
- `meus_registros_cubit.dart` -- unchanged; `activeSource`/`activeDateFrom`/`activeDateTo` getters reused read-only
- `date_range_preset.dart` -- unchanged

## Tasks & Acceptance

**Execution:**
- [x] `entries_repository.dart` -- add `source`/`dateFrom`/`dateTo` to `search()`
- [x] `entries_remote_data_source.dart` -- forward new params to `entries-search`
- [x] `entries_search_cubit.dart` -- add filter fields, `_lastQuery`, `updateFilters()`; wire into `_search()`
- [x] `entries_filter_sheet.dart` -- add `searchCubit` param; bridge in `_applyAndClose`
- [x] `meus_registros_screen.dart` -- pass `searchCubit` down; bridge chip-remove/"Limpar"; drop funnel's `ResourceIdle` gate; render chip row over search results too; reset `searchCubit`'s filters in `initState`
- [x] Unit tests covering every I/O Matrix row
- [x] Widget tests: chip row + funnel fill during active search; Aplicar/Limpar/chip-remove mid-search

**Acceptance Criteria:**
- Given an active search term and no filters, when a filter is applied, then the funnel fills and the chip row appears above the search results.
- Given combined search+filter results on screen, when "Limpar filtros" is tapped, then results update to unfiltered semantic-search results for the same query, with no search-box or screen disruption.

## Design Notes

Filter state is duplicated, not shared — RNF06 forbids one cubit importing the other, so the screen is the only legitimate bridge.

## Verification

- `fvm flutter analyze` -- expected: zero issues
- `fvm flutter test` -- expected: all tests pass

- `MeusRegistrosScreen` threads `searchCubit` into `EntriesFilterSheet`/`_ActiveFiltersRow` (new required param on both); their 4 filter-mutating call sites (`_applyAndClose`, chip-remove ×2, "Limpar filtros") also call `searchCubit.updateFilters(...)` right after the existing `cubit.applyFilters()`/`clearFilters()`.
- Funnel fill (`meus_registros_screen.dart:217-219`) drops its `ResourceIdle` gate — becomes `widget.cubit.hasActiveFilters` unconditionally. `_ActiveFiltersRow` renders above `_SearchResults` too, same condition.
- Clearing the search box while filters stay active needs no new code — `MeusRegistrosCubit`'s filtered state is already kept current in the background regardless of which branch is visible (5.2, unchanged).
- `MeusRegistrosScreen.initState()`'s existing `cubit.loadFirstPage()` call also calls `searchCubit.updateFilters(source: null, dateFrom: null, dateTo: null)` — both cubits are `lazySingleton`s, so a fresh mount must reset both, or a re-entered screen carries a stale filter from a previous visit into a still-active search.

**Ask First:** none — scope pinned by `epic-5-context.md` and RF06.

**Never:** the two cubits importing each other (RNF06) — filters flow only via the screen bridge; a debounce on the filter-triggered re-search; a "CATEGORIA"/tag filter; changing `_loadFiltered()`'s own background `entries-list` query.

## I/O & Edge-Case Matrix

| Scenario | Input / State | Expected Output / Behavior | Error Handling |
|----------|--------------|---------------------------|----------------|
| Apply filter during active search | search "ansiedade" active, Aplicar "áudio" | one `entries-search` call: `q=ansiedade&source=audio` | N/A |
| Clear filters during active search | source+date active + search term, "Limpar filtros" tapped | re-queries `entries-search` with only `q`; box/screen undisturbed | N/A |
| Remove one of two chips mid-search | source+date active, search active, "x" on source chip | re-queries `entries-search` with `q` + remaining date range | N/A |
| Filter applied/cleared/box emptied while search idle | empty box | stored silently; `entries-list` queried (5.2 path, unchanged), no `entries-search` call | N/A |
| Re-enter screen after a prior combined session | leave with search+filter active, return | both cubits' filters reset on `initState`; no stale filter carried forward | N/A |

</frozen-after-approval>

## Code Map

- `entries_repository.dart:88` -- `search()` signature to extend (`entries_repository_impl.dart:135-136` is a thin pass-through, unaffected beyond the new params)
- `entries_remote_data_source.dart:125-143` -- `search()` param-building, mirrors `list()` (:65-96)

- `entries_filter_sheet.dart:38-96,121-130` (`_applyAndClose`)
- `meus_registros_cubit.dart` -- unchanged; `activeSource`/`activeDateFrom`/`activeDateTo` getters reused read-only
- `date_range_preset.dart` -- unchanged

**Execution:**
- [x] `entries_repository.dart` -- add `source`/`dateFrom`/`dateTo` to `search()`

Filter state is duplicated, not shared — RNF06 forbids one cubit importing the other, so the screen is the only legitimate bridge.
